name: dialog
useFor: Use for a short task that needs full attention (New automation) or a result to read before moving on (a new API key). Put the title and description in DialogHeader, fields in DialogBody, and the actions in DialogFooter: one ink Button for the main action, an outline DialogClose for Cancel. Use asChild or render on DialogTrigger to open it from a Button.
constraints: Two ink keys in the footer
A dialog that opens another dialog
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website's popups and keys: the square ground panel and quiet line (.hn__sheet), the ink at 32 percent from the brand principles, Chakra Petch light titles and the hexagon keys (.button, .button--line).
title: Dialog
description: A square 512px panel of the ground with 24px of air, a quiet hairline and a deep soft cast, centered over the ink at 32 percent: a Chakra Petch light 20px title, a 14px graphite description, hexagon keys at the end of the footer and a compact ghost X in the corner. It opens in place from 0.96 with a fade. A dialog taller than the screen scrolls and fades at the screen edge it scrolls past (fade-y).
